easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or higher.
description:
Cast Yawgmoth's Will by paying {2}{B}
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping it and exiling it due to Yawgmoth's Will, choosing Mirror of Fate and up to six other cards from exile, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library, ensuring to place Mirror of Fate on top of your library.
Cast Mirror of Fate from the top of your library by paying 5 life due to Bolas's Citadel
Repeat from step 2.
